So a retired account's late decrypt error (sign-out deletes the entry, so a missing-entry error is plausible) sets a hold and failures++ on the next account. Both scratch tests are red as described. GitHub codes are lowercase snake_case, so the 'alternating unknown codes' acceptance line is not contradicted in practice. The test reproduces specified behaviour.

'monotonic' appears nowhere in docs/specification/github-sign-in.md, while 6.5 still says `until: now() + ...`.
